description: Aggregate results of a sample of unexposed outputs in the UTXO set at block height 975019, each checked against a third-party public Esplora API. No addresses, scripts, outpoints or transaction ids are included.

sample.drawn_by: An audit extension of utxo-census, in the same run that wrote the utxo-census-audit files. The extension and the per-type lists of unexposed output scripts it wrote are not in this repository.
sample.unexposed: The output script is not listed as revealed at the snapshot height by the exposure tables of the 975019 scan.
sample.unit: Output (UTXO), not output script: each type's sample is a simple random sample of that type's unexposed outputs.
sample.method: Per output type, a uniform reservoir of 2000 UTXOs over the snapshot (Algorithm R driven by splitmix64), from which 250 UTXOs with an unexposed output script were selected.

rule: A sampled output counts as a hit when a transaction confirmed at height 975019 or lower has an input whose previous output carries the same scriptPubKey as the sampled output.
not_counted: Outputs whose scriptPubKey was spent only at heights above 975019 are not hits: at the snapshot height that script had not yet appeared in a spending input.

data_source.kind: Third-party public Esplora REST API, not the tables in this repository.
data_source.querying_script: Not in this repository; neither is the script that wrote this summary.

upper_bound_method.per_type: One-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the share of hits among the type's unexposed outputs; with no hits among n outputs it is 1 - 0.05^(1/n).
upper_bound_method.all_four_types: One-sided 95% upper bound on the share of hits among all unexposed outputs of the four types, sum_i w_i p_i, where w_i is the share of type i in the counts listed under weights (its count divided by their sum): its maximum over the hit shares p_i with (1 - p_1)^250 (1 - p_2)^250 (1 - p_3)^250 (1 - p_4)^250 >= 0.05, the exact 95% confidence region when every type has no hits. With these weights the maximum has p_i = 0 for every type except the one with the largest weight, so the bound is w_max * (1 - 0.05^(1/250)).
upper_bound_method.weight_unit: Unexposed outputs of each type at the snapshot height, the unit the sample was drawn in.

runs.ended: Stopped after the third HTTP 429 response; row 267 was left unresolved and checked again in the second run.
